about: Texture slots for THE THIRD LAMP vertical slice. Each 'name' is loaded from Assets/_Project/Resources/ThirdLamp/Textures/<name>.png if present; otherwise the procedural placeholder in Scripts/World/Tex.cs is used. Generate with PixelLab (or any tool), keep the size/aspect, set Texture Type = Default, Import settings are applied automatically from this file by Editor/ThirdLampTextureImporter.cs (kind: tex | decal | sprite | cookie; decals and sprites keep alpha). Style for everything: grounded early-2000s Greek domestic realism, muted tungsten palette, slightly degraded, no fantasy colour, no text unless specified.
style_reference: realistic, low-saturation, warm tungsten indoor light, early 2000s, slightly worn, photographic texture feel rendered at low resolution

slots.name: painting_eight
slots.prompt: 19th-century unsigned oil painting, dusk landscape in Greece, eight robed figures seen from behind standing in a loose semicircle around a small dark spring pool, cypress trees on the left and right horizon, low olive-green hills, ochre sky darkening upward, a grey rock at lower right with a tiny painted mark (circle above a vertical line above a triangle), aged varnish, fine craquelure
slots.notes: Master image. Figures must all face the water, backs to the viewer.

slots.name: painting_nine
slots.prompt: IDENTICAL to painting_eight, pixel for pixel, except: add one small pale robed figure far in the background at the tree line on the right, between the cypresses, facing OUT of the painting toward the viewer, pale face, two dark dots for eyes
slots.notes: Make this by editing/inpainting painting_eight, not by regenerating. Every other pixel must match or the photo comparison breaks.

slots.name: icon_027
slots.prompt: fragment of a 15th-century Byzantine egg-tempera icon on wood, gold-leaf background, an unidentified saint with a halo in a dark red robe, dark red border band, upper-right corner broken off showing raw wood, and a tiny cream-coloured mark painted into the lower-left border: a circle above a vertical line above a triangle
slots.notes: The mark must be small, near UV (0.04, 0.13).

slots.name: disc_014

slots.notes: Circular object centred in the square; the cylinder cap samples it planar.
